name: Estrategia de Inteligencia Artificial 2024
description: Estrategia de Inteligencia Artificial 2024 (approved by the Council of Ministers on May 14, 2024). Spain's national artificial intelligence strategy led by the Ministry for Digital Transformation and the Civil Service, covering supercomputing infrastructure, the ALIA Spanish/co-official language foundational models, public sector AI deployment, and oversight by the Spanish Agency for the Supervision of AI (AESIA).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Departamento de Seguridad Nacional (dsn.gob.es) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Departamento de Seguridad Nacional (dsn.gob.es).
